subject: Venue evaluation + HA AV failover plan for client workshop
messages:
From: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
To: sam.ortiz@brightline-av.com, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, markus.klein@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Cc: evan.park@aureliabiotech.com
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Venue evaluation + HA AV failover plan for client workshop

Team / Sam,

We need to finalize venue + A/V resiliency for Aurelia's 2-day executive workshop (Dec 7-8). Key asks from the client: zero audible dropouts on the bridge, native laptop sharing for 2 concurrent breakout rooms, and a 10-minute seamless failover to an alternate bridge if the primary loses connectivity.

What I need from Brightline by EOD Monday:
- Confirmation that the proposed venue (see attached floorplan) supports two independent bridges with active/passive failover and test steps.
- Simple diagram of the failover path (WAN -> primary MCU -> secondary MCU) and expected RTO/RPO.
- Rack power & network run checklist for the on-site gear (PDUs, redundant NICs).
- Quote for on-site 24/7 AV tech + remote bridge monitoring for the two days.

Attachments: venue floorplan (Aurelia_Workshop_Floorplan_v3.pdf).

Laura/Markus/Monica: please chime in on capacity and any constraints from Redwood side (headcount, secure network reqs). Evan: FYI — we'll share Brightline's HA plan and confirm this meets your compliance needs before booking.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Enterprise SDR | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0142
From: sam.ortiz@brightline-av.com
To: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: ops@brightline-av.com, evan.park@aureliabiotech.com
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 11:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Venue evaluation + HA AV failover plan for client workshop

Ben — thanks for the clear checklist. Quick summary from ops:

1) Venue constraints: The conference center's primary network provider only exposes a single VLAN to the event space; we recommend a redundant LTE/WAN uplink for the secondary bridge.
2) Failover topology: we can run active/passive bridging using Brightline Cloud MCU + on-site edge gateway; failover tested at ~75 seconds RTO in our lab (we'll run a live failover drill during setup).
3) Power/network: we require 2x dedicated 20A circuits at the AV rack and a /29 public IP block (or bridged NAT with port mapping).
4) Quote: attached (Brightline_Quote_4552.pdf) — includes 24/7 on-site tech, cloud MCU entitlement for 2 bridges, and LTE failover (hot standby).

Attachments: Brightline_Quote_4552.pdf, initial HA diagram attached inline.

We'll prepare the formal HA diagram and the rack/run checklist by Monday. Do you have an internal contact for Redwood's network team who can confirm firewall rules?

—Sam Ortiz
Director of Solutions | Brightline AV
sam.ortiz@brightline-av.com
(415) 555-0219
From: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
To: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com, markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
Cc: sam.ortiz@brightline-av.com, evan.park@aureliabiotech.com
Date: Mon, 8 Nov 2026 08:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Venue evaluation + HA AV failover plan for client workshop

Thanks Sam — looks promising. Couple of Redwood-specific constraints:
- We cannot expose customer PII to Brightline's cloud MCU without a data processing agreement; Ben, please confirm if Aurelia is comfortable with that or we push for an on-prem relay.
- On redundancy: Markus, can the Redwood bridge appliance (we'd bring one for the event) be configured to act as the active endpoint with Brightline as failover? That avoids sending audio/video to a third-party cloud by default.

Monica: travel & logistics check — we need to confirm hotel room blocks for the execs and a dedicated green room for the board members with a 1G wired drop. Can you get availability + ETA for tech arrival windows?

Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Programs | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
From: monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
To: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
Cc: evan.park@aureliabiotech.com, sam.ortiz@brightline-av.com
Date: Mon, 8 Nov 2026 13:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Venue evaluation + HA AV failover plan for client workshop

Laura — booking update: hotel blocks are available at The Channel Suites (walking distance) and the Marriott Exec. Block holds: 18 rooms + 4 suites for Dec 6-9. I have provisional holds; will release on Nov 15 unless we confirm.

Tech arrival windows: Brightline requested 8 hours for rack build & config on Dec 6 (night before). Redwood bridge appliance can arrive Dec 6 AM; Markus, can you confirm a 6-hour overlap window for testing the active/passive failover? Also note: client requires KMS-backed key handling for any recorded session — Evan, confirm if Aurelia will permit recordings.

Attachments: AV_HA_Failover_Specs.xlsx (contains test script we will use).

Monica
Monica Patel
Event Programs Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
From: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
To: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com, markus.klein@redwoodinference.com

Date: Mon, 8 Nov 2026 17:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Venue evaluation + HA AV failover plan for client workshop

Great progress — short next steps: 
1) Sam / Brightline: please share the formal HA diagram + rack/run checklist by EOD Tuesday (Nov 10). Confirm LTE provider and SIM hot-swap SOP.
2) Markus: confirm Redwood appliance can be configured active with Brightline passive fallback; need confirmation by Tue EOD.
3) Monica: hold Channel Suites block and confirm green room drop; push for suite with private ethernet. Release date 11/15 if we don't confirm.
4) Laura: I'll draft an addendum to Aurelia with the data handling options (cloud MCU vs on-prem relay) and share for Evan to approve.

If any of the above misses the Tue deadline we push booking to next available venue date.

Thanks all — I'll run a 30-min sync on Wed 11/10 9:30am PT if needed (calendar invite to follow).

Ben

Senior Enterprise SDR | Redwood Inference
